payload.state: Cingular to Cut About 7,000 Jobs (Reuters) Reuters - Cingular Wireless will cut about 7,000\jobs, or 10 percent of its work force, to cut costs as it\integrates recently purchased AT T Wireless, the company said\on Tuesday.

criteria.sports: Sports news: games, matches, athletes, teams, leagues, scores, transfers and results.
